newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks slightly higher in morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks slightly higher in morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were slightly higher in early Wednesday morning trade, as the yen's decline against the dollar inspired some buying in export-strong issues, brokers said.
They added, however, that the market lacked a concrete direction and trade was likely to be fairly subdued for most of the day.
As of 0018 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was up 8.59 points, or 0.05 percent at 18,573.37. Its March futures were unchanged from Tuesday's level at 18,580.
